summary: StealthGas Inc., a Marshall Islands-incorporated Greek LPG shipping company, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a proxy statement and proxy card for a Special Meeting of Stockholders on December 11, 2026 at 11:00 a.m. Greek local time in Kifissia, Athens. The meeting asks holders of record as of November 4, 2026 to approve a related-party 'Vessel Acquisition' described in Proposal One, with board-solicited votes via internet, telephone, or mail. No price, stake, premium, or advisor is disclosed in the excerpt; the circular is a routine meeting notice, so this is not classified as a special situation. Watch for the full Proposal One terms, related-party identity, and any dissent or proxy solicitation ahead of the vote.
